term: quitar el guante de la cara

1.consolidated_definition: Dejar de acosar, de hostigar. “Mami, quítame el guante de la cara, dame un break.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To cease harassing or pestering someone; to give someone a break. "Mom, take the glove off my face, give me a break."
